Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final transparent equipment icon atlas for Éter Anima autochess, twenty individual painted icons.
Generate exactly 20 distinct highly polished anime fantasy equipment icons arranged in a precise regular 4 COLUMN x 5 ROW grid, equally sized square cells, row-major order below. Canvas portrait aspect 4:5, intended 1024 x 1280. Each icon centered within its own cell, occupies 65–72% of cell width/height, generous transparent gutters of at least 32 pixels on every side. Every cell has ONE isolated item silhouette, no shared ornaments or background.
STYLE: exquisite clean line art and cel shaded fantasy anime, lustrous gold hardware, crisp visible jewel facets and distinctive readable silhouettes even at 48 pixels, cohesive academy magic aesthetic. NOT photorealistic, NOT generic flat vector symbols, NOT cartoon toy render. Real transparency around every object, no backplates, no square cards, no borders, no text, no labels, no numbers, no humans.
ROW 1 left-to-right: 1 a compact elegant silver ether sword with brass ruby hilt (Lâmina de Éter); 2 round blue lunar orb nested in a delicate gold crescent (Orbe Lunar); 3 deep indigo folded guardian cloak with gold clasp (Manto Guardião); 4 amber violet mechanical magic heart crystal in a gold cage with fine electric prongs (Núcleo Pulsante).
ROW 2: 5 small ivory gold mana seal talisman holding a cyan gem, engraved abstract nonalphabetic ornament (Selo de Mana); 6 solar lion jaw blade with two golden teeth-like edges and warm red gem (Mandíbula Solar); 7 black ink quill with a silver blade tip and blue fractured crystal (Pena da Ruptura); 8 crimson stitched cloak clasp with an elegant red thread and dagger ornament (Costura Carmesim).
ROW 3: 9 three slim violet gold conductive nails bound by an amber electric loop (Pregos do Último Acorde); 10 compact leather duelist codex and inset crossed silver blades, no writing (Códice do Duelista); 11 black ivory book clasped around a violet eclipse orb, no writing (Eclipse da Página); 12 small ornate blue silver cathedral reliquary surrounded by crystalline frost (Catedral de Inverno).
ROW 4: 13 crystalline gold flower with azure petals and violet electricity (Flor da Tempestade); 14 dark sapphire crescent chalice with a flowing cyan tide jewel (Maré sem Estrelas); 15 sturdy miniature mineral throne armor breastplate with amber strata gems (Trono Mineral); 16 radiant gold silver guardian shield with sun ruby and small white feathers (Guarda da Alvorada).
ROW 5: 17 graphite white folded anti magic mantle with a cracked gold seal (Manto da Página Livre); 18 violet gold resonant tuning fork with two electric hearts (Réquiem Condutor); 19 compact golden metronome with violet lightning crystal and conductive nails (Compasso de Vajra); 20 ivory silver sanctuary pendant with a circular cyan healing crystal and small white floral edging (Santuário do Retorno).
Strict count and layout: 4 columns, 5 rows. All twenty centered items entirely contained within their independent square cell with transparent whitespace. Do not paint guidelines or a checkerboard.

Cells equally sized squares. Each frame center is exactly the center of its cell, all visible energy entirely contained within inner70%of each cell with large transparent gutters, no glow crossing adjacent cells. Real RGBA transparent background. Crisp luminous painted anime cel shaded energy with fine calligraphic flame curves and cut crystal highlights. No background, no black tiles, no card borders, no UI, no humans, no text, no digits, no letters, no checkerboard. Strictcount6columns4rows. This is a smooth chronological sequence drawn by hand. Stable anchoring, each frame independent, consistent visual quality.
